summary: Allied Gold Corp filed a Form 6-K on October 6, 2026, attaching a press release reporting exploration results at the Kurmuk Mine in western Ethiopia as commissioning completes and operations begin. Disclosed intercepts include Ashashire hole ASDD227 with 13.86 m at 10.07 g/t Au and 13.77 m at 9.15 g/t Au, plus Dish Mountain and Tsenge Trend results. The release cites planned life-of-mine output of at least 240,000 ounces annually, averaging roughly 300,000 ounces over the first four years. No transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms were stated. Watch commissioning ramp-up and resource conversion.
